role: A Gson TypeAdapterFactory that serializes enums as their lowercase names; registered in the IChatComponent/ChatStyle pings and the resource-pack metadata serializer.
notes: Its users are the server-list ping JSON (S00PacketServerInfo), the resource-pack metadata serializer (IMetadataSerializer) and the chat Gson in IChatComponent; none of these run in this game's loopback channel, and there is no JSON layer natively. idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
scope_reason: A Gson adapter for the server-list ping, resource-pack metadata and chat JSON; none of those is parsed in this game's state path, and native reads no JSON of that kind.
